case_number: 2025 INSC 403; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) No. 15254 of 2024)
summary: Murder conviction under IPC s.302; inconsistent eyewitness testimonies; PW-1 bloodstain contradiction; PW-2 unnatural conduct in not reporting to police; PW-3 partial testimony; benefit of Exception 4 to s.300 IPC granted; conviction set aside; acquittal ordered.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
